mapper.select: SELECT g.*, s.student_no, u.real_name as student_name, c.course_name, u2.real_name as teacher_name FROM grades g LEFT JOIN students s ON g.student_id = s.id LEFT JOIN users u ON s.user_id = u.id LEFT JOIN courses c ON g.course_id = c.id LEFT JOIN teachers t ON g.teacher_id = t.id LEFT JOIN users u2 ON t.user_id = u2.id WHERE g.id = #{id}

SELECT g.*, s.student_no, u.real_name as student_name, c.course_name, u2.real_name as teacher_name FROM grades g LEFT JOIN students s ON g.student_id = s.id LEFT JOIN users u ON s.user_id = u.id LEFT JOIN courses c ON g.course_id = c.id LEFT JOIN teachers t ON g.teacher_id = t.id LEFT JOIN users u2 ON t.user_id = u2.id WHERE g.student_id = #{studentId}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO grades (student_id, course_id, teacher_id, semester, usual_score, exam_score, total_score, grade_level, remark) VALUES (#{studentId}, #{courseId}, #{teacherId}, #{semester}, #{usualScore}, #{examScore}, #{totalScore}, #{gradeLevel}, #{remark})
